name: Drei Grafen
beschreibung: Hotel Drei Grafen is located in the historic Old Town of Innsbruck. The surroundings offer a mix of baroque architecture and lively shopping streets. The rooms are furnished in a traditional country-house style and have free Wi-Fi. The hotel's own restaurant focuses on regional cuisine. The atmosphere of the family-run establishment is personal and quiet. Guests looking for a combination of city exploration and alpine activities will find a suitable starting point here. The nearest ski lift can be reached by public transport. A small wellness area is available for relaxation.
